sampling.position_distribution: 1D Gaussian relative coordinate mapped through B(q)=B0/(1+q/R)^6
sampling.doppler_distribution: 1D Gaussian common-mode Doppler detuning in current symmetric 6D model
sampling.component_definition: excess process infidelity relative to nominal decay+Gaussian-edge optimized fixed phase sequence

model_limitations: Thermal blockade and Doppler terms are averaged separately and then added at first order.
The Doppler response uses common-mode detuning only; independent-velocity differential coupling to the antisymmetric single-Rydberg state is not included in this 6D symmetric basis.
The fixed nominal virtual-Z phases are used for each noise sample, because random thermal shifts are not assumed to be known shot by shot.
